name: lares-native
description: Capacitor Android shell for Lares — loads the GitHub Pages site in a WebView so the app has its own launcher icon and survives Chrome being blocked

scripts.build:apk: node make-icons.mjs && capacitor-assets generate --android && sed -i 's/android:allowBackup="true"/android:allowBackup="false"/' android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
